definitions.explanation: The whitish mineral deposit left by hot water inside kettles, pots, bathtubs, and water heaters. Also used for the film that builds up on the inside of a bath.

examples.japanese: やかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{湯垢|ゆあか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた。
examples.english: Scale has built up in the kettle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{湯垢|ゆあか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こすって⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: I scrub off the scum in the bathtub.

examples.japanese: {湯垢|ゆあか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧クエン⟦{酸|さん}→酸：28620_san⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: Limescale comes off nicely if you use citric acid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{洗|あら}っていて→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{浴槽|よくそう}→浴槽：04985_yokusou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{湯垢|ゆあか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまっていく。
examples.english: Even if you wash it every day, scum gradually builds up in the bathtub.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water) + ⟦{垢|あか}→垢：19701_aka⟧ (grime, dirt). It refers to deposits left by the water itself, mostly minerals, rather than to body dirt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湯垢|ゆあか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: scale forms
- {湯垢|ゆあか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる: scale builds up
- {湯垢|ゆあか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to remove scale
- {湯垢|ゆあか}{取|と}り: scale remover (product)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水垢|みずあか}→水垢：30399_mizuaka⟧: water stains — the same kind of deposit left by cold water, on sinks and faucets
- ⟦{垢|あか}→垢：19701_aka⟧: grime — the general word, including dirt from the skin
